headnodz.bio: Headnodz is a Toronto hip-hop production identity associated with producers Nick Holder and Kaje and the city's Treehouse Records circle. The project produced material for Canadian underground artists including Citizen Kane, Mathematik, Reign and Dub Ill during Treehouse's independent rap run. Northern Dial carries Headnodz as part of its foundational Toronto producer catalogue.

ro dolla.bio: Ro Dolla is a Toronto artist, producer and creative known for his work with The Circle and the R&B and hip-hop group Big Black Lincoln. A longtime figure in Toronto music, he has collaborated with artists including Saukrates and Choclair while extending his creative work beyond recording. Northern Dial carries Ro Dolla as part of its Toronto hip-hop and R&B history catalogue.

c4.bio: C4 is a Toronto rapper associated with the Jane and Finch area and the city's underground street-rap scene. He has also been connected with The Corps and appears in Toronto hip-hop coverage under the name C4, including the alias Fourrrr. Northern Dial carries C4 as part of its Toronto hip-hop catalogue.

jhevon paris.bio: Jhevon Paris is a Canadian rapper, singer and producer closely associated with Toronto's late-2000s pop, R&B and hip-hop scene. His credits include collaborations with Canadian acts such as Stereos and Divine Brown, along with production and guest-vocal work across major-label Canadian releases. Northern Dial carries Jhevon Paris as part of its Toronto crossover and hip-hop catalogue.

froboii.bio: Froboii is a Toronto-area hip-hop artist, songwriter and producer whose catalogue includes independent solo releases and collaborations within the city's current rap scene. His artist channels connect him directly with Toronto's 6ix-branded performance circuit and collaborators including Charmaine, JayTrillz and PHB Hollis. Northern Dial carries Froboii as part of its contemporary Toronto hip-hop catalogue.
